'''Arsitta Kushoe''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. She was the reason the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Evram Darkmere]] reformed himself and began aiding the Alliance. Kushoe later went missing in action.
